title: Lightly Fermented Japanese Peaches Bao
description: A Japanese-inspired bao filled with lightly fermented peaches, katsuramuki-cut and served with a side of spicy sauce.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine peaches, salt, honey, fennel seeds, and black pepper. Let it sit at room temperature for 2 hours to lightly ferment.
Preheat a steamer basket with boiling water. Steam the bao dough for 10 minutes.
Using a katsuramuki cutter, cut the steamed bao dough into thin slices.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the rice vinegar to the pan and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Place the katsuramuki-cut bao onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the bao with the spicy sauce.
Bake the bao in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10 minutes.
Serve the bao warm with a side of spicy sauce.
Note: You can adjust the amount of honey and rice vinegar to your taste.
